desc: Analyze divisibility rules for digits 1-9 to determine efficient counting strategies.
Categorize digits: Coprime to 10 (1,3,7,9) use prefix sums with modular inverse; Divisible by 2 or 5 automatically (2,5); Last 2 digits rule (4); Last 3 digits rule (8); Divisible by 2 and 3 (6).
Implement the `countSubstrings` method handling each category separately.
Test the implementation against provided examples.
